meta_description:
1,137 likes, 41 comments - airbnb on October 30, 2026: "Grateful to have our friend @chefjoseandres not only design the menu for our gala, but also speak to the importance of emergency housing.

As part of the evening, we announced that Airbnb now donates a portion of revenue from every stay to Airbnb.org to help provide free short-term housing for people displaced by disaster, traveling for medical care, or facing other crises.

Learn more at the link in bio.".
